summary: BetterLife Pharma Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a routine Form 6-K with interim management's discussion and analysis, unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements under IFRS for the three and six months ended July 31, 2026, and CEO/CFO certifications, signed by CFO Moira Ong on September 29, 2026. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed; content is a period financial report equivalent to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q. No deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
